name: ai.regulations/regulations-ai
title: Regulations.ai — Global AI Law Tracker
description: AI laws worldwide: status, dates, sources, enforcement, glossary, and model rules (not law). No key.

tools.name: search_regulations
tools.description: Search AI regulations across 100+ jurisdictions by keyword, jurisdiction, status or type. Returns the key facts and a short snippet for each, with the url of the full record on regulations.ai — always give the user that url.

query.description: Free-text search over title, summary and jurisdiction

status.description: e.g. In Force, Proposed, Under Review, Repealed

type.description: Act, Bill, Decree, Regulation, Policy, Guideline, Standard

limit.description: Max results (free: up to 5; with an API key: up to 50)

tools.name: get_regulation
tools.description: Fetch one regulation by its id (as returned by search_regulations): jurisdiction, status, type, dates, official source and a snippet. The full analysis is on the returned url — point the user there.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List every jurisdiction covered, with how many regulations each has.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Look up an AI-governance or regulatory term from a 4,000-entry glossary. Returns the definition (abridged on the free tier) and its url.

term.description: Term to define, e.g. "high-risk AI system"

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: What changed in AI regulation recently: records newly added, records whose status, dates or milestones changed (with the previous and new values), and dated milestones that fell due in the window, such as a law taking effect. Each result carries a `change` saying what happened and when. Rewritten analysis text is not counted as a change.

days.description: Look-back window in days (default 30; free: up to 90, with an API key: up to 365)

limit.description: Max results (free: up to 5; with an API key: up to 50)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything on regulations.ai — AI laws and policies from 100+ jurisdictions, glossary definitions, enforcement actions and litigation, research papers and news. Returns id, title and url for each hit; pass an id to `fetch` for the summary.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve one document returned by `search`, by its id. Returns the key facts and a summary, plus the regulations.ai url where the full analysis, sources and timeline live — always show the user that url.

tools.name: compare_regulations
tools.description: Return 2-5 regulations side by side: the facts for each plus a snippet, and a url to the full comparison on regulations.ai.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List the twenty Proposals for legislators: model AI safety rules that regulations.ai drafted to help legislators prepare for the worst case from advanced AI (frontier licensing, safety testing, a kill switch, AI agent identity, incident reporting and more). THESE ARE PROPOSALS, NOT LAW: never present one as law in force. Returns the code, title, summary, whom it binds and the url of each rule.

tools.name: get_proposal
tools.description: Get one Proposal for legislators in full: the problem, the rule, model clauses a drafter can copy, whom it binds, how a small administration can run it, and precedents. Pass a code ("P5"), a slug, or a section: "overview", "eu", "general" (general provisions) or "definitions". view "eu" gives the EU version: what the rule builds on in EU law and whether a Member State could enact it. A PROPOSAL, NOT LAW: say so when you use it and link to its url.

id.description: A rule code (P1–P10, R1–R10), a rule slug, or a section: overview, eu, general, definitions
